text:
Kai (Support): FYI - Orion Systems says the enterprise promo credit from their PO never showed up on their account. Sales (Jamal) confirmed the PO note asked for a 50k onboarding credit. Customer is blocked on usage spikes. Can someone triage? cc @Jamal (sales) :exclamation:

Jamal (Sales): I added the PO note exactly as we agreed: 'ContractPromo: ORION-ONBOARD-50K' and attached the signed PO PDF to the order. Sales confirmed with procurement. I can forward the contract.

Priya (AcctOps): Can you paste account id + invoice numbers? Is there a billing entry at all? I can look up the ledger.

Kai (Support): Account: acct_ORION. Invoice: INV-7723 (generated 2026-02-28). I ran a quick check in the billing UI — no credit posted. Attached the PO PDF in thread (uploaded).

billing-bot: Invoice INV-7723 — credit_balance: 0.00; promo_code: null; last_applied_by: system-parser; status: cleared.

Kai (Support): Repro steps I used: 1) load account; 2) check invoice list; 3) call internal apply-credit endpoint with the PO note payload. Response: 400 Bad Request from promo-parser: 'unrecognized_po_note_format'.

Avery (SRE): If the promo-parser is throwing that, can you paste the exact payload you sent? Also grep the parser logs for acct_ORION around 2026-02-28.

Kai (Support): payload I used (sanitized):

```
POST /internal/v1/credits/apply
{
  "account_id": "acct_ORION",
  "amount": 50000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "contract promo",
  "po_note": "ContractPromo: ORION-ONBOARD-50K",
  "source": "sales-po"
}
```

Response: 400 {"error":"unrecognized_po_note_format","details":"no promo id parsed"}

Avery (SRE): Thanks — that matches a known edgecase where hyphenated promo IDs in PO note PDFs don't match our regex. I'll pull the promo-parser service logs: `kubectl logs deploy/promo-parser | grep ORION-ONBOARD` and check if parser attempted to map to a promo id.

Priya (AcctOps): While SRE looks, @Eli (Finance) we might need a manual ledger adjustment if the parser can't auto-apply. What's your process for one-off enterprise credits?

Eli (Finance): I can do a manual credit but need (A) signed PO or contract confirming the promo, (B) approval from sales (Jamal), and (C) a GL code. Create a ticket and tag me. Impact: $50k revenue deferral/credit.

Jamal (Sales): I approve. Contract link: https://docs.google.com/d/ORION-contract-2026 (signed by customer). PO number 78934 included in the doc.

Priya (AcctOps): Created ticket REF-4521 in AcctOps -> Manual Credits. Notes: acct_ORION, INV-7723, credit 50000 USD, reason 'Enterprise onboarding promo per signed PO 78934', assigned to Eli (Finance). Attached contract and PO PDF.

Eli (Finance): Received REF-4521. I'll run the manual ledger entry tonight and post the journal reference. Will also mark it as 'contract promo — sales approved'.

Avery (SRE): Quick follow-up — filed bug in infra: PROMO-PARSER-221, reason: parser regex doesn't accept uppercase + hyphen pattern when prefix contains 'ContractPromo'. Assign to infra-team.

Kai (Support): Customer updated: "Thanks — awaiting credit so we can scale; please let me know when applied." I'll follow up once finance confirms.

Eli (Finance): Manual journal applied. Journal ref: JRN-90021. Credit posted to INV-7723 for 50,000 USD. REF-4521 updated with journal ref and I attached accounting screenshot.

Kai (Support): Confirmed in billing UI: credit now visible, balance updated to -50,000 on INV-7723. Messaging customer now. :white_check_mark:

Jamal (Sales): Thanks team — I've flagged the revenue ops impact with the AE.

Priya (AcctOps): Closing REF-4521 after recon tomorrow. Also adding note to sales playbook: include explicit 'promo_id' field in order metadata to avoid parser.

Kai (Support): Customer notified and unblocked. Closing thread. :tada:
